class MissingReferenceErrorTests(unittest.TestCase):
    """InterpolationMissingOptionError via real ConfigParser.get."""

    def _check_exc(self, exc, opt, sec, ref):
        self.assertIsInstance(
            exc, configparser.InterpolationMissingOptionError)
        self.assertEqual(exc.option, opt)
        self.assertEqual(exc.section, sec)
        self.assertEqual(exc.reference, ref)
        self.assertTrue(exc.message)
        for fn in (copy.copy, copy.deepcopy):
            e = fn(exc)
            self.assertEqual(e.option, opt)
            self.assertEqual(e.section, sec)
            self.assertEqual(e.reference, ref)
            self.assertEqual(e.args, exc.args)
            self.assertEqual(e.message, exc.message)
        for proto in range(pickle.HIGHEST_PROTOCOL + 1):
            r = pickle.loads(pickle.dumps(exc, protocol=proto))
            self.assertEqual(r.option, opt)
            self.assertEqual(r.section, sec)
            self.assertEqual(r.reference, ref)
            self.assertEqual(r.args, exc.args)
            self.assertEqual(r.message, exc.message)
            self.assertEqual(repr(r), repr(exc))

    def test_basic_missing(self):
        cp = configparser.ConfigParser(
            interpolation=configparser.BasicInterpolation())
        cp.add_section('s')
        cp.set('s', 'v', 'Hi %(gone)s')
        with self.assertRaises(
                configparser.InterpolationMissingOptionError) as cx:
            cp.get('s', 'v')
        self._check_exc(cx.exception, 'v', 's', 'gone')
        self.assertEqual(cp.get('s', 'v', raw=True), 'Hi %(gone)s')
        cp.set('s', 'gone', 'Yo')
        self.assertEqual(cp.get('s', 'v'), 'Hi Yo')

    def test_extended_missing(self):
        cp = configparser.ConfigParser(
            interpolation=configparser.ExtendedInterpolation())
        cp.add_section('s')
        cp.set('s', 'v', 'Hi ${gone}')
        with self.assertRaises(
                configparser.InterpolationMissingOptionError) as cx:
            cp.get('s', 'v')
        self._check_exc(cx.exception, 'v', 's', 'gone')
        self.assertEqual(cp.get('s', 'v', raw=True), 'Hi ${gone}')
        cp.set('s', 'gone', 'Yo')
        self.assertEqual(cp.get('s', 'v'), 'Hi Yo')

    def test_extended_cross_section_missing(self):
        cp = configparser.ConfigParser(
            interpolation=configparser.ExtendedInterpolation())
        cp.add_section('a')
        cp.set('a', 'r', '${b:gone}')
        cp.add_section('b')
        with self.assertRaises(
                configparser.InterpolationMissingOptionError) as cx:
            cp.get('a', 'r')
        self._check_exc(cx.exception, 'r', 'a', 'gone')
        self.assertEqual(cp.get('a', 'r', raw=True), '${b:gone}')
        cp.set('b', 'gone', 'Yo')
        self.assertEqual(cp.get('a', 'r'), 'Yo')
